newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Kazakh Nat Bank lowers refinancing rate to 30 pct.
newsitem.headline: Kazakh Nat Bank lowers refinancing rate to 30 pct.

text.p: The National Bank of Kazakhstan said on Wednesday it was lowering its refinancing rate to 30 percent annually from 35 percent from May 1 this year.
It said in a statement it was also lowering its Lombard rate to 28 percent annually from 30 percent while its overnight rate will be reduced to 23 percent from 25 percent.

"Inflationary tendencies and indicators for the market in state treasury paper answer our expectations and we think we can make a brave move forward by lowering the refinancing rate," Uraz Dzhandosov, the National Bank chairman, said last week.
The refinancing rate was raised to 35 percent in October last year from 32 percent.
The Lombard and overnight rates were first introduced on March 3 this year, at 30 percent and 25 percent respectively.
